orchestratorPreconditions: Run and freeze true A business/routing correctness without this observer first.
Use a distinct query/output directory for the subsequently observed resource shape; do not label a later run on an attached process as unobserved.
Bind PID/executable SHA/startTicks/home/conf/JMX/MPP/server SHA from actual started DataNode records.
Freeze the queried source FI and all receiver bucket/exchange IDs independently with the production driver.
Keep source active under a deterministic resource shape; a fast 24-row run may finish before any sample.
Stop/read each observer window and persist returned evidence; root orchestration still owns DataNode shutdown and six-node rollback.
runtimeEvidenceChecks: At least one matching actual source handle, source FI equals frozen production producer.
32 distinct channel object tokens and 32 observed receiver FI/plan-node bindings matching frozen bucket edges.
Local channels expose distinct actual queue/source-handle bindings; all channels read the same producer query/FI/plan key and same actual MemoryPool object.
All 32 actual channel/queue maxBytesCanReserve values and actual sink cap are retained; compare against the independently frozen A contract without deriving values from a constructor formula.
Actual pool account leaf exists under the observed shared key; retain measured reserved bytes, including a positive running sample.
Only a captured matching future with isDone=false counts as pending; a queue entry or constructor does not prove backpressure.
If a round-robin strategy has channelMemoryThreshold, read it directly; PLAIN/no field remains absent, never fabricated as zero.
Use repeated stable identity/key/cap samples plus independent execution to assess concurrent reads; no atomic global-state claim.
Window must finish with referencesReleased=true and zero retained production-object/field/verification caches; truncation/read errors are explicit and must not be hidden.
Original server JAR/classfile bindings before/after unchanged; observer-bearing run remains distinct from the clean A correctness run.
